children: Australian shares edged lower on Tuesday, as National Australia Bank's restructuring costs weighed on financials, while top miner BHP slipped on a decline in quarterly copper production.

shares fell as much as 2.6% after the world's top copper producer posted a steep drop in first-quarter copper output after inclement weather and a fatal accident forced temporary halts at its Escondida mine in Chile.
Investors now await comments from Reserve Bank of Australia Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser on Wednesday, when he is likely to be asked about the chance of a fifth rate hike this year.
Westpac expects core inflation to rise 0.9% this quarter, lifting annual inflation to 3.5% against the RBA's 3.3% forecast.
Even so, Westpac analysts expect the central bank to stand pat, as below-trend growth and a gradually easing labor market should be enough to bring inflation back to target.
